rows.notes: Under construction, active: Agratas 7 Jul 2026 update says cladding is progressing on Building One (first phase); UK govt GBP380m grant 13 Apr 2026 (S05). start_year 2027 = first factory building opening postponed from 2026 to 2027 (S06, Apr 2025); S08 electrive (Feb 2025, updated Apr 2026) still says 'production scheduled to start in 2026' - conflict, later and more specific source wins. Other search-snippet-only items (not opened, so not evidence): first phase 'late 2027', permanent substation not before late 2028 (switchgear-magazine Apr 2025 page opened: 'will not be operational until late 2028'), Somerset Council withdrew GBP150m (Feb 2026), Sir Robert McAlpine left (Jun 2026). Nameplate 40 GWh/yr is the site's stated annual capability (S07, S08); no phase GWh breakdown or full-capacity year found -> capacity_ref_year 2025 is the fallback (publication year of the source stating the plan), ref_year: fallback, searched. v1 ref year 2030 ('early 2030s') had no opened source -> replaced. v1 chemistry 'mixed (NMC and LFP)' and cell_format null: no opened source names chemistry (Agratas says it is adaptable) -> chemistry null; prismatic format appears only in search snippets -> null. end_market EV kept (JLR/Tata Motors anchor); electrive also says stationary storage/2-wheelers planned. announced_year not re-verified -> null. Coordinates unchanged from v1.

Altris Ferrum in Sandviken is a cathode-active-material plant (2000 t/yr Fennac Prussian-white cathode, 'enabling 1GWh' of sodium-ion cells elsewhere), not a cell plant (S09 Altris release, 3 May 2022). The 1 GWh is a battery-equivalent of the cathode, not cell output. No open source shows Altris making cells in Sweden. A chemxplore aggregator page lists Ferrum as 'Cancelled' (search snippet only, not opened) and Altris' 2026 cathode scale-up is at Draslovka in Kolin, Czechia (snippet only) - not evidence. Per scope rule (materials excluded) removed.

No page dated after Feb 2024 found (searched 2025-26 for LionVolt Thurso: nothing) - silence, current output unknown. v1 0.1 GWh/yr was a single-tracker figure for the old AMTE small-batch line -> nulled; chemistry/format/end_market null (v1 values described AMTE's old products, LionVolt's future cells are 3D solid-state lithium-metal per press).
